messages:
anya-ux: Quick thread: proposing we regroup the left rail by task clusters (Deployments, Models, Billing, Settings) rather than org hierarchy. Main goals: make it faster to get to intent-driven flows and simplify onboarding. Thoughts?

pete-fe: Task clusters make sense. Implementation note: keep collapse state purely visual (no history.push/replace). We should route panels with a query param (panel=overview|metrics|logs) so back-button behavior is predictable.

kim-a11y: Accessibility requirements: when a deep link opens a panel, move keyboard focus to the panel H1 and place an aria-live announcement "Opened: <PanelName>". Skip links order should be: Skip to Main, Skip to Projects, Skip to Search. Also ensure breadcrumb uses aria-current on active item.

tara-prod: Product asks that legacy links continue to work. Proposal: server-side redirect map from /workspace/:id/* to /projects/:id?panel=... and additionally allow fragment anchors for lines e.g. ?panel=logs&anchor=line-78. Also prefer nav label 'Projects' and tooltip: "Projects — your team workspaces."

pete-fe: Router sketch:
```
/app/:org/projects/:projId?panel=logs&anchor=line-78
- route changes -> history.pushState
- UI-only toggles -> purely CSS, NO history modification
- on deep-link open -> wait for fragment, then set focus and announce
```
I'll add e2e tests for fragment scroll+focus ordering.

anya-ux: Breadcrumb semantics: show task path like "Projects > AcmeApp > Logs". Use chevrons and no trailing punctuation. When the sidebar is collapsed, breadcrumb must still surface the panel level.

kim-a11y: Also: suppress non-essential modals on deep-link arrival (they steal focus). Delay auto-popups by ~250ms or disable when initial location includes panel/anchor.

deploy-bot: deploy: sidebar-ia-demo build #4902 succeeded :white_check_mark:

pete-fe: I'll open a PR tomorrow implementing panel query param routing, compatibility redirects, and the focus/announce behavior. Will ping for a11y review.

anya-ux: Great. Locking on task clusters + panel query param routing for initial rollout. Small follow-ups: keyboard palette behavior and copy for "copy link" toast (e.g., "Link copied — opens Logs at line 78").
